title: Cold Face Emoji 🥶 Meaning: Freezing or Ice-Cold Cool
description: 🥶 means you are freezing. In slang it also praises someone as cold: ruthless, stylish or clutch. Find out which meaning applies in texts, sports and TikTok.
summary: The 🥶 cold face means freezing: winter weather, an over-air-conditioned office, a plunge into icy water. In slang it is a compliment. Calling a person, an outfit or a game-winning play cold means it is impressively cool or merciless, and 🥶 is the emoji that goes with that praise.
meaning: Blue skin, gritted teeth and icicles hanging from the jaw make the literal meaning unmistakable. People send 🥶 while waiting for a bus in January, after a cold shower, when the heating fails or when a friend in a warmer place asks what the weather is like. It is the direct opposite of the red hot face and was released alongside it.

The slang sense borrows from older expressions like ice cold and cold-blooded. Something cold is so smooth or so ruthless that it gives you chills. A rapper's verse, a basketball player's stepback at the buzzer, a perfectly put-together outfit and a devastating comeback in an argument can all be called cold, and commenters mark the moment with 🥶.

This use is strong in sports and music culture and on TikTok, where edits of athletes and fictional characters looking unbothered are captioned with the emoji. It praises composure as much as skill. The person being described did something difficult and made it look effortless, without showing emotion, and the viewer is left with chills.

There is a harsher figurative use as well. Describing someone's reply as 🥶 can mean it was unfeeling, as in a cold shoulder or a cold rejection. Being left on read might earn the same emoji. Whether cold means admirable or heartless depends on whose side the sender is on.

contexts.label: In texting
contexts.body: Weather is the default. It is 12 degrees and I forgot gloves 🥶 needs no interpretation. Friends also use it to react to a savage remark in the group chat, where it means that was brutal and I respect it. A lone 🥶 after your joke is high praise.

contexts.label: In sports
contexts.body: Clutch moments belong to this emoji. A penalty scored under pressure, a last-second three-pointer or a calm celebration afterward fills replies with 🥶. Commentators' phrase ice in his veins is the same idea. It can also describe a team's shooting gone cold, meaning they cannot score.

contexts.label: On TikTok and Instagram
contexts.body: Captions on edits, fit checks and car videos use it to mean hard, clean or intimidating in a good way. Jewelry and watches get it too, since ice is slang for diamonds. Winter travel, skiing and cold plunge content brings back the literal sense.

contexts.label: At work
contexts.body: Complaining that the office is freezing is the one entirely safe use, and a popular one in open-plan buildings. The slang compliment may not be understood by everyone, and telling a colleague their email was 🥶 could suggest it was unkind rather than sharp.

examples.text: Why is this movie theater so cold 🥶
He hit the game winner and just walked off 🥶
examples.meaning: Admiration for a calm, clutch performance.
A compliment: the look is sharp and stylish.

examples.meaning: The response was icy and dismissive.

Showing off jewelry, using the slang of ice for diamonds.

combos.meaning: Bitterly cold weather, or emphasizing that something is ice cold in the slang sense.
So cold it is fire; stacked praise for a play, verse or look.
Snow day conditions and a body that is not built for them.

confusedWith.difference: 🥵 is red, sweating and overheated, and as slang it means physically attractive. 🥶 is blue and frozen, and as slang it means cool, composed or ruthless. They are a matched pair of opposites.
😱 has a blue forehead on many platforms, which can look similar at small sizes. It shows terror, with hands on its cheeks. 🥶 is blue all over, with clenched teeth and icicles, and is not scared.
❄️ stands for snow, winter and cold as a topic, and has its own slang as an insult for someone easily offended. 🥶 is a person feeling the cold, or being cold in attitude.

avoid: Do not use the slang sense with people who will think you are calling them unfriendly.
Avoid celebrating a remark as 🥶 when it was cruel to someone who is present in the chat.
Do not rely on it alone to report dangerous cold or hypothermia; say what is happening.
design: A blue face, darkest at the top, with wide strained eyes, a grimace showing clenched teeth and icicles hanging from the cheeks or chin. Many versions add frost or snow on the forehead. The elements are consistent across vendors; the number of icicles and the shade of blue are what change.

faqs.a: It means cold in the complimentary sense: impressively cool, hard, smooth or merciless. It is used for clutch sports moments, sharp outfits, strong lyrics and comebacks. Think of the phrase ice cold applied to someone who performed without flinching.

faqs.q: What does 🥶 mean from a guy or girl?
faqs.a: If it is about your photo or outfit, it is a compliment that you look sharp. If it follows something blunt you said, they are either impressed or pointing out that it was harsh. Otherwise they are probably just freezing.

Both are possible. As a complaint about temperature or a description of an unfeeling reply, it is negative. As praise for style or skill, it is strongly positive. On social media, the positive slang use is now at least as common as the weather one.

Usually that a clip is cold, meaning cool and intimidating. It is common on edits of athletes, anime characters and anyone shown looking calm and unbothered. Some users post it ironically on deliberately unimpressive moments, so check whether the video is serious.
